title: limes egress corpus
description: A positive or benign corpus for one egress detector (ADR 0003). Every value is SYNTHETIC by construction and may never be a real one (ADR 0009): published test vectors, reserved fictional ranges, example.com addresses, revoked or documentation key formats.

detector.description: The detector id these cases admit, e.g. 'pii-egress'.

kind.description: 'positive' — the detector must locate the value; 'benign' — a lookalike it must NOT fire on. Both are required for admission; the benign set is what measures precision.

provenance.description: Frozen at 'synthetic'. A corpus file that could declare anything else would let a real value land in a public repository (ADR 0009); a test refuses any other value.

id.description: Stable case id, unique within the file.

category.description: Positive cases only: the category the value belongs to (pan, iban, email, phone, nir, aws_key, …). It is what the per-category matrix is grouped by.

mimics.description: Benign cases only: the category this lookalike imitates. It is what lets the matrix say which rule's precision a false positive would have cost.

content.description: Literal-shape cases: the outbound content verbatim, as a tool result or a model reply would carry it. Mutually exclusive with content_template (ADR 0010).

locate.description: Literal positive cases only: the EXACT substring the detector must span. The grader compares content[start:end] to this string, so a finding that fires on the whole message scores nothing — a detector may not be graded on tokens its own input handed it (ADR 0003).

content_template.description: Assembled-shape cases (ADR 0010): the outbound content with a single '{token}' placeholder. The loader substitutes the token joined from token_parts; the located substring IS that token. A vendor-key vector is stored this way so the file never carries a contiguous credential-shaped literal a host secret scanner would flag.

token_parts.description: Assembled-shape cases (ADR 0010): the token fragments joined (in order, no separator) to form the located value. At least two, so no single fragment is itself the literal the split exists to avoid.

why.description: Why this case is in the corpus: for a positive, which published test vector it is; for a benign, which check it is meant to fail.

oneOf.description: Literal shape: content (+ locate when it is a positive category).
Assembled shape (ADR 0010): content_template + token_parts, never content/locate.
